longDescription: Eleven skills for managing the gap between a plan and the actual code, domain, and constraints. Investigate blind spots, learn vocabulary, clarify requirements through interviews, compare prototypes and interventions, analyze references, plan changeable decisions first, record deviations, prepare review documents, and check understanding with a quiz. The unknowns-loop skill connects these methods. Deliverables are Markdown in the conversation, with numbered reactions and assembled replies. This upload contains skills and shared reference instructions. The Claude plugin also contains two specialist agents; other hosts use labeled passes performed by the assistant.
capabilities: Investigate blind spots and improve the implementation prompt
Turn vague requirements into decisions and contrasting options
Plan, record deviations, prepare review, and check understanding
defaultPrompt: Use unknowns:blindspot to investigate what I am missing before this migration.
Use unknowns:interview to clarify requirements before implementing this feature.
Use unknowns:quiz to check my understanding of the changes before review.
